inputs.name: llvm-project
inputs.purpose: The LLVM, Clang, and LLD sources that the package builds. The digest is the sha256 published in the upstream release metadata (gh api repos/llvm/llvm-project/releases/tags/llvmorg-<version>).

inputs.name: musl
inputs.purpose: The static libc bundled in the package. The digest is the sha256 of the upstream release tarball from musl.libc.org.

inputs.name: zlib
inputs.purpose: The zlib linked into the shipped LLVM tools, built GCC-free by stage 1. The digest is the sha256 of the upstream release tarball, signed by Mark Adler (key 5ED46A6721D365587791E2AA783FCD8E58BCAFBA).

inputs.name: mimalloc
inputs.purpose: The allocator linked into the shipped LLVM tools, built GCC-free by stage 1. The digest is the sha256 of GitHub's archive of the upstream v2.5.2 tag.
